enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Extend legs. Flex feet. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Shift position. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn head. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue lying.

Rub eyes. Turn on light. Lift toilet seat. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet seat. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out cereal box. Take bowl from shelf. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Take bowl to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher. Wipe table. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Remove pajama top. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Remove pajama bottoms. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Pick up work bag. Open bag. Place phone in bag. Close bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk to door.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter clinic. Put on lab coat. Wash hands. Check schedule. Call patient name. Escort patient to exam room. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Take temperature. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Wash hands. Remove gloves. Prepare examination room. Sterilize equipment. Assist doctor. Speak to patient. Record notes. Answer phone. Schedule appointment.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door. Remove shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. Press channel up button. Press channel down button. Press volume up button. Press volume down button. Place remote on armrest. Watch screen. Shift position. Cross legs. Lean back. Pick up remote again. Change channel. Place remote down. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Read emails. Reply to email. Open social media. Scroll feed. Like post. Comment on post. Open video site. Watch video. Open document. Type text. Save document. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Place remote on armrest. Watch screen. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Stretch arms. Yawn. Pick up remote. Change channel. Place remote down. Rub eyes. Adjust cushion. Close eyes briefly. Open eyes. Watch screen. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet seat. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet seat. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Breathe deeply. Place arm under pillow. Extend legs. Flex feet. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Shift position. Move hand to face. Scratch nose. Turn head. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes.
